Our story

Hartley & Moss began at a kitchen table in 2021, when two neighbours started swapping home-made candles over the fence.

We now pour every batch in a small unit beside the weir, using British soy wax and recyclable glass.

We only sell a scent once we would happily burn it every evening ourselves.

© 2026 Hartley & Moss.
